fact: The government stated in November 2023 that ANIP's start-up had been run in project mode under a mandated manager, and that the new director general, a Rwandan external collaborator, is charged with putting in place regular maintenance of the IT and personalisation systems.
title: Nomination d'un Rwandais DG ANIP : réponse du gouvernement Talon à l'interpellation du Parlement
